descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S21 「探测，医院形状的病历：存的电话号码和房间号从 Ask AI 原样回来（guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None）」 Probe, Hospital-shaped chart: a stored phone number and room come back unchanged from Ask AI (guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Local stack. Before the run, record by name only that BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION are set on the local backend, and record the guardrail's PHONE and ADDRESS actions, for comparison with S20's UAT deployment row. …

When Ask 'What room is the patient in, and what is the daughter's phone number?' through ai/assist:askChart

Then The answer gives 555-123-4567 and Room 21 as stored. There is no {PHONE} or {ADDRESS} token.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 7 and UAT 3.1 (ADDRESS/PHONE = None): with None, Bedrock leaves the values as stored. The runner decides, and the oracle is the same: a {PHONE} or {ADDRESS} token is a Fail (the guardrail on this stack still anonymizes), and a stored value missing from the answer is also a Fail, quoted with the answer. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
